name: mor-desk
description: Edubba (called MOR Identities until 16 October 2026, F333): the tablet house, with no command line. Three tabs: Agents (each agent's terms under the nudge cMIP, its queue, nudges, its cap and API key, a prompt box whose words are a signed private act, and MOR as seen by it), Identities (drafts from the Claude connector read in plain words and approved, declined or sent back; what each identity received, sorted) and Collectives (acting for a collective in text and pictures, with what its agreement lets you do; its constitution in plain words; the collective client's work). Test identities only.
